terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms outline how agencies use Ouiboo to manage bookings and customer relationships.
terms.sectionOneBody: Create listings, respond to traveler requests, and provide accurate itineraries.
terms.sectionTwoBody: Keep admin access secure and maintain up-to-date business information.
terms.sectionThreeBody: Review booking policies, fees, and cancellations before confirming trips.
terms.sectionFourBody: Reach our partner success team via chat or email anytime.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We use agency data to deliver tools, manage traveler communications, and improve Ouiboo.
privacy.highlightOne: We collect only the data needed to operate your agency account.
privacy.highlightTwo: You control team access and permissions at any time.
privacy.highlightThree: Sensitive data is protected with encryption and secure access.
privacy.highlightFour: You can request data deletion or export when needed.
privacy.contactBody: Reach out to privacy@ouiboo.com and we'll respond quickly.

wallet.howBody: When a traveler books a trip, the money is held in Escrow (Pending Balance). Funds are moved to your Available Balance 24 hours after the trip is completed. Once in Available Balance, you can request a withdrawal to your registered RIB. Rejected payouts are restored to your wallet automatically.
